findings.title: Free-pilot customer invoicing is not blocked by the backend
findings.evidence: Private zero-value free-pilot fixture accepted a positive INR 1000 invoice and transitioned it to PAYMENT_PENDING.
findings.reproduction: module_audit_management.py / Free pilot: backend blocks customer invoicing

findings.title: Reapproval popup disappears after approval revocation with an invoice draft
findings.evidence: Actual revoke endpoint succeeds and tracking returns can_approve=true, but the source popup queue is empty.
findings.reproduction: module_audit_management.py / Draft exists: reapproval action remains visible in popup

findings.title: Pending purchase requests are missing from Management approval notifications
findings.evidence: A real purchase request returns pending_approval, but the designated Management recipient receives no matching item from the approval-category notification API. Reproduced by an independent test run.
